en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural inn or guesthouse complex labeled "Daubnitz. Gasthof." The main building is a two‑storey gabled house with a tiled roof and several windows, surrounded by a fenced garden. A small stream runs along the right side bordered by leafless trees, and a footpath follows the water. In the foreground, a simple wooden fence encloses a yard where a few people stand. The overall appearance suggests an early 20th‑century Central European village scene.
